description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single ranged attacks (0.60 each), grants [Instant Cast 1] and [Critical Damage +50%] to all allies, grants [Awoken Fire], [Damage Cap +10000] and [Dark Ammo Shot Follow-Up] to the user

description.name: Critical Damage +50%
description.text: Critical hits deal 50% more damage (additive with the base critical coefficient)

description.name: Awoken Fire
description.text: Fire abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Fire abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Dark Ammo Shot Follow-Up
description.text: Casts Dark Ammo Shot after using a Fire ability
